parameters.name: AlertLevels
parameters.description: The list of alert notification levels.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page when paging is used in a paged query.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the asset instance.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the asset instance.

parameters.name: Operation
parameters.description:
The type of operation performed on the file. Valid values:

- **DELETE**: deletes the file.
- **WRITE**: writes to the file.
- **READ**: reads the file.
- **RENAME**: renames the file.
- **CHOWN**: changes the file owner and associated group.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page when paging is used in a paged query.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The name of the configuration rule.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The event status. Valid values:
- **0**: Unhandled.
- **1**: Handled.
- **2**: Whitelisted.

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the server to query.
> Call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
